journey.name: Onboarding to Auth Navigation
journey.description: Verifies the app launches to onboarding and can navigate to auth screen

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Onboarding screen
Verify that a "Get Started" or login button is visible
Tap the "Get Started" or login button
Verify that the Auth screen is shown with email and password fields

journey.name: User Registration
journey.description: Tests the full registration flow for a support seeker

actions.action: Navigate to the Auth screen
Tap the "Create Account" button to switch to registration mode
Verify that display name field, role spinner, and anonymous checkbox are visible
Enter "testuser@hearu.com" in the email field
Enter "password123" in the password field
Enter "Test User" in the display name field
Select "Support Seeker" from the role spinner
Tap the "Sign Up" button
Verify that the app navigates to the Chat screen or shows an error message

journey.name: User Login
journey.description: Tests the login flow with email and password

actions.action: Navigate to the Auth screen
Verify that the Login button is visible
Enter "testuser@hearu.com" in the email field
Enter "password123" in the password field
Tap the "Login" button
Verify that the app navigates away from the Auth screen or shows an error

journey.name: Login Input Validation
journey.description: Tests that invalid inputs show proper error messages

actions.action: Navigate to the Auth screen
Leave the email field empty
Enter "ab" in the password field
Tap the "Login" button
Verify that an error message about invalid email is shown
Enter "valid@email.com" in the email field
Clear the password field and enter "12"
Tap the "Login" button
Verify that an error message about password length is shown

journey.name: Bottom Navigation
journey.description: Tests that bottom navigation works correctly between all tabs

actions.action: Navigate to the Chat screen (login first if needed)
Verify that a bottom navigation bar is visible
Tap the "Profile" navigation item
Verify that the Profile screen is shown
Tap the "Settings" navigation item
Verify that the Settings screen is shown
Tap the "Chat" navigation item
Verify that the Chat screen is shown
Tap the "Home" navigation item
Verify that the Chat screen is shown

journey.name: Start AI Chat Session
journey.description: Tests starting an AI chat session and sending a message

actions.action: Navigate to the Chat screen
Verify that a message input field and send button are visible
Enter "I feel overwhelmed today" in the message input field
Tap the send button
Verify that the sent message appears in the chat list
Verify that a response message appears (either from AI bot or loading indicator)

journey.name: Settings Screen Interactions
journey.description: Tests that settings toggles are interactive

actions.action: Navigate to the Settings screen
Verify that toggle switches are visible for notifications or dark mode
Tap a toggle switch
Verify that the toggle state changes

journey.name: Auth Mode Toggle
journey.description: Tests switching between login and registration modes

actions.action: Navigate to the Auth screen
Verify that the screen is in Login mode (display name field hidden)
Tap the "Create Account" button
Verify that registration fields are now visible (display name, role spinner, anonymous checkbox)
Tap the "Switch to Login" button
Verify that registration fields are hidden again
